tex_content.html: \begin{example} \end{example}[The shallow water equations] 1. ch11:11.1-ex-3\group Conservation Laws The one-dimensional shallow water equations are \[ \begin{cases} \phi _t + (v\phi )_x = 0 & \text{(conservation of mass)} \\ v_t + (v^2/2+\phi )_x = 0 & \text{(conservation of momentum)} \end{cases} \] in $\mathbb {R}\times [0,\infty )$. In these equations $v$ is the horizontal velocity, $\phi $ denotes $gh$, where $h$ is the height and $g$ the gravitational constant, and \[ \mathbf{F}(z) = \left(z_1z_2, \frac{(z_2)^2}{2} + z_1\right). \] \end{example}
